title: SOTS: Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.31525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training data selection for machine learning models is a critical bottleneck in industrial applications where expert annotation is costly and time-consuming. Existing coreset selection methods for time series either ignore temporal structure entirely or cannot handle variable-length, irregularly sampled, multi-channel signals, the setting most common in industrial monitoring and testing. We introduce SOTS (Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection), an unsupervised coreset selection framework for irregular multivariate time series (IMTS) classification. Each sample is mapped to a truncated path signature, capturing the joint geometric structure of its channels, and the coreset is selected by greedily minimizing the Sliced Wasserstein distance between the empirical signature distributions of the candidate subset and the full dataset, a criterion for which we establish a convergence guarantee for random coresets. translated_title: SOTS：基于签名的最优传输选择
translated_abstract: 在工业应用中，由于专家标注成本高且耗时，机器学习模型的训练数据选择成为一个关键瓶颈。现有的时间序列核心集选择方法要么完全忽略时间结构，要么无法处理变长、不规则采样、多通道信号——而这正是工业监测与测试中最常见的场景。我们提出了SOTS（Signature-based Optimal Transport Selection，基于签名的最优传输选择），一个面向不规则多变量时间序列（IMTS）分类的无监督核心集选择框架。每个样本被映射到一个截断路径签名，以捕捉其各通道的联合几何结构；随后通过贪心地最小化候选子集与完整数据集的经验签名分布之间的切片Wasserstein距离来选择核心集，我们为该准则建立了随机核心集的收敛性保证。我们在一个re……
tldr: SOTS提出了一种无监督核心集选择框架，通过将不规则多变量时间序列映射为截断路径签名并贪心最小化子集与全量数据之间的切片Wasserstein距离来选择训练数据，同时提供了随机核心集的收敛性理论保证。
en_tdlr: SOTS is an unsupervised coreset selection framework for irregular multivariate time series classification that maps each sample to a truncated path signature and greedily minimizes the Sliced Wasserstein distance between the subset's and the full dataset's signature distributions, with a proven convergence guarantee for random coresets.
